COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No.1068 of 2021
Hon 'b le Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.
Mr. Gopal K Verma, Advocate, for the
petitioners.
 Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, Standing Counsel,
for the State of Uttarakhand.
The writ petition was allowed by this
Court vide its judgment dated 28.03.2022. The
petitioners contended, before this Court that the
said judgment has not been complied with.
Hence, the respondents were directed to file
compliance affidavit. The respondents have
filed the compliance affidavit through IA No.05
of 2022, wherein, they have shown the amount
of money, which was otherwise directed to be
paid has been disbursed to the petitioners, but
the counsel for the petitioners submits that it is
not a complete compliance of the judgment
rendered by this Court, because part of the
judgment for taking an action against the
authorities has not been complied with.
In that eventuality, if the petitioners are
still dissatisfied with the compliance made of
the judgment rendered by this Court on
28.03.2022. The petitioners may have their
recourse to an appropriate remedy available to
them under law, for part of the judgment, which
has not been complied with.
Accordingly, the compliance affidavit is
taken on record, and the writ petition is closed.

( Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.)
 01.07.2022
